column1: # DEV-c: projects (pj). Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: One list of running tmux sessions, git repos (with their worktrees), and zoxide directories. Enter attaches to the project's session or creates it (code / sh / ai windows, or the repo's trusted .tmux-session.toml); over a terminal it switches that terminal, over any other window it opens a new one. In the list: o a window of its own, d kill the session, w new workmux task, c clone from gh / glab, t trust the repo's layout file. Same list in tmux (prefix F) and in the shell (Ctrl+X p).

column3: New workmux task in a project (worktree + agent window)
column9: Pick a repo, then a branch (or type a new name): workmux creates the worktree and a wm-* window in the repo's project session, and the terminal switches to it.

column3: Clone a repository (gh, glab) and open it
column9: Lists your gh repositories (user and orgs) and glab projects from an hour-old cache, asks for the destination (default ~/job/NAME), clones and opens the project session. One-time: gh auth login.
